nodes.title: Bypassing Z-I-T
widgets_values: Bypass Z-I-T subgraph and load using Load Image node's output into Encode subgraph if you already have an image to work with.

nodes.title: Output resolution
widgets_values: Change width/height on top to change output resolution

nodes.title: Part Specific Lora
widgets_values: You can edit HIGH-NO-Lora, HIGH and LOW power lora loader nodes inside I2V subgraphs to enable part specific loras.

nodes.title: How to extend further?
widgets_values:
To add more parts simply;
- copy the last I2V-Extend subgraph
- ctrl + shift + v to paste with connections
- set prev_samples to previous node's latent
- set source images to previous videos extended images
- connect new node's extended images to save node on the right

nodes.title: How to change steps?
widgets_values:
Total steps is total steps..
No lora steps is where high noise  without lightx2v ends.
High end step is where high noise ends and low noise starts.
